verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents self-hosting directly: free Docker self-hosting, self-hosting on your own infrastructure, on-premise enterprise deployment, and a desktop app that runs entirely on the user's computer. Kubernetes probe fixes and a public GitHub repo support server deployment, and community users report installing and running it locally. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting/Docker deployment guide in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of Docker/server self-hosting (community reports are mostly about the desktop install).
